articles.title: NFT startup founder charged with misusing funds from $10 million fundraising
articles.snippet: Federal prosecutors say Taj Tarsha misled backers and used investor funds for personal expenses.

articles.title: Feds Say an NFT Founder Raised $10 Million Only to Blow It All on Gambling, Trading, and a DJ Hobby
articles.snippet: Prosecutors say the founder of NFT marketplace Few and Far promised investors their money would build a Web3 platform before diverting it to personal expenses.
